description.value: Sushi Iwa is a Japanese restaurant on White Rock's Marine Drive waterfront strip, offering a broad menu spanning nigiri, sashimi, aburi oshi, classic and specialty rolls, teriyaki, donburi, and bento boxes. It has outdoor seating and supports online ordering with DoorDash delivery. The restaurant is well-positioned along a popular coastal cycling corridor connecting White Rock to the wider South Surrey trail network.
